name: AI Assistant (AIA)
description: AI-powered Drupal site-building automation: generate content types, fields, taxonomies, blocks, views, menus, and paragraph types from natural-language prompts, with a mandatory dry-run preview and full rollback.
project_description: AIA (AI Architect / AI Assistant) turns natural-language prompts into real Drupal configuration. Through a Drush CLI or an admin web form, a site builder describes a goal in plain English ("a product catalog type with title, SKU, price, and images") and AIA plans, previews, and applies the matching structural changes. It ships seven AiaAction plugins: generate_content_type, add_field, generate_taxonomy, generate_view, generate_block, generate_menu, and generate_paragraph_type (Paragraphs optional). A free-form router (AiaActionRouter) picks the right action, or plans a multi-step pipeline executed under one session ID. Every operation is a two-phase dry-run then apply: the AI response is JSON-schema and business-rule validated, a colour-coded diff is shown, and only an explicit confirm/apply writes to the site. Each applied change is logged as an aia_task content entity with a rollback link and task-history report. The AI backend is pluggable via the ai module (AIRequestService), and a keyword-driven MockAIRequestService is wired as the default service for cost-free, deterministic development and testing.
